comment: Published catalogue values of the FANUC ROBODRILL alpha-D21MiB5 Plus (FANUC America product page 'α D21MiB5 Plus', fanucamerica.com/products/robodrill/a-d21mib5-plus): travels 500 x 400 x 330 mm, 24000 min-1 (listed as the high-speed spindle; check which one the machine has), rapids 54 m/min, programmable cutting feed 30000 mm/min, 21 tools, 0.9 s tool change, BBT30 holders, ROBODRILL 31i-MB5 Plus control. Spindle power and torque, acceleration and rigid tapping are not stated there: 0 / false = unknown. Axis directions are not stated; travels are given from 0. Not verified on a real machine.
name: Generic Fanuc-controlled VMC (ROBODRILL class)
